What is the Fear & Greed Index?

It measures the emotion driving the crypto market by combining volatility, momentum, volume, social media and Bitcoin dominance into a single 0–100 score.

How traders use it

Extremes often mark turning points — extreme fear can signal a market that's oversold (a possible buying opportunity), while extreme greed warns the market may be due for a pullback. It's one signal among many, not a timing tool on its own. Pair it with the Screener and your own plan in Paper Trade.
